input.quote: 10.3 Assignment. This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 is a binding-effect provision only: it neither permits nor restricts assignment, so it fails the fallback checklist (no successor assignment right with notice, no consent requirement for other assignments, no reasonableness standard) and leaves HDI free to assign the Agreement, including to a competitor of ours, without our consent. There is no blanket prohibition on our assignment and no change-of-control termination right in Section 4.1 or elsewhere, so this is not walk-away territory, but the clause is silent on every checklist element. We therefore added the preferred assignment mechanics in one short clause after 10.3: our free assignment to affiliates and M&A successors, HDI assignment only with our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a competitor, and express confirmation that our change of control gives HDI no termination right.

proposal.summary: Add assignment mechanics: Company free assignment to affiliates/successors, HDI assignment only with our consent and never to a competitor, and no HDI termination right on our change of control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 only addresses binding effect, so it leaves HDI free to assign the Agreement while giving us no express affiliate or M&A carve-out. We have added our standard assignment terms: we may assign to an affiliate or successor without consent, HDI may assign only with our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a competitor, and a change of control of the Company gives HDI no termination right.

ops.text: The Company may assign this Agreement, without HDI's consent, to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets. HDI may not assign this Agreement without the Company's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and may not in any event assign this Agreement to a competitor of the Company. A change of control of the Company shall not give HDI any right to terminate this Agreement.

mappings.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without consent.
Customer may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without consent.
Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent.
Customer's consent to Vendor assignment is not to be unreasonably withheld.
Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor.
Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination right.
